response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.death_country,'') AS country, AVG(CAST(v.points_won AS REAL)/v.points_max) AS avg_share FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max <> 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(p.death_country,'')) SELECT country, avg_share, avg_share / (SELECT AVG(avg_share) FROM c) AS relative_ratio FROM c
